title: 12-apps §18.4.1 SOS rate limit keyed on source IID — unimplementable under upstream addressing
description: Edge-pass finding from project-LICHEN-worker6-0adq (same defect class as the §6.3.3 relay-key fix, left behind in another file). spec/12-apps.md:725 (§18.4.1 SOS rate limiting) tracks '(source IID, SOS count, last SOS uptime)'. Under upstream-yggdrasil-addressing the primary /128 embeds no IID, so for flooded SOS traffic carrying the primary source the IID is not in the packet and this keying is unimplementable — exactly the gap fixed in spec/04-network.md §6.3.3. Re-key on the full 16-byte primary source address (or scope the entry to link-local-sourced SOS only, if SOS is specified as link-local — check §18.4). Distinct from ikcx/qe4q (those are implementation bugs in existing rate limiters).
close_reason: Fixed the unimplementable 'source IID' rate-limit key: spec/12-apps.md §18.4.1 now keys on the full 16-byte IPv6 source address (preserved end-to-end per 04-network.md §6.3.2) — the same accounting key as the §6.3.3 broadcast relay budget, with its spoofed-source ceiling inherited; IID extraction forbidden (primary /128 embeds no IID, §6.2); key aligns with the §18.4.2 alert payload node identifier. NOTE: initial fix keyed on verified LLSec SIID; all 3 delegated kimi-k3 passes independently flagged it as WRONG past hop 1 (LLSec re-signing: 06-security:64-71, 02-physical-link:305-308) — reworked in-round to /128 keying per reviewer consensus (matches §6.3.3, my 0adq fix). Review findings filed as new beads: SOS origin-signature vs hop-by-hop re-signing contradiction (P1 — 12-apps:707-709 is itself unimplementable multi-hop), confessions board IID keying (P2), trust-store LRU replay-window flush (P3), SOS tuple missing SOS-ID/seq + rotation resets buckets (P3). Correctness P3 (identifier-space gap) resolved by the /128 key matching the alert payload node field. No tests applicable — prose-only; §18.4 implementation is open spec-gap l1qw.37.
